name: Prambanan Temple Compounds
description: Prambanan is a vast Hindu temple complex on the plains of central Java, about 17 kilometres northeast of Yogyakarta. Built in the 10th century, it is Indonesia's largest Shiva temple site. Its tallest tower soars 47 metres, flanked by shrines to Vishnu and Brahma, with carved reliefs telling the Ramayana epic along the walls.
